evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Quinton performs urgency-as-worry: the emphatic 'whole reason' and the causal framing of past failures as necessitating the gate register high-arousal negative valence.

mints.name: IncidentDrivenMandateUrgency
mints.title: urgency to mandate a gate because of past incidents
